font_glyphs.description: Static native-font glyph, metric-table, and geometry inputs. Resident native-font metric decoding and draw adjustment.

font_glyphs_native.description: Use NUN5's native 14x20 raster geometry and packed metrics for every same-semantic English glyph, reconstruct unsupported punctuation from clean NA2, preserve clean GF4C, bound the secondary atlas, and use descriptor height only for the secondary glyph quad.

font_glyphs_metrics.description: Decode the accepted packed 14x20 metric rows for measurement and drawing from composition-time C in 228.BIN, leaving only guarded register-setup hooks in the fixed boot ELF.

font_layout.description: Static font layout, contextual presentation, alignment, and formatting call-site inputs. Resident font measurement, fitting, wrapping, positioning, and caller adapters.

font_layout_character_modal.description: Use independently measured local X positions for all five Back to Game Mode Screen modal rows and place the structural fifth-row footer at local Y 115.

font_layout_linked_mode_modal.description: Match the dedicated Linked Mode title and both selector rows to NUN5 with one local title origin and one shared choice base and interval; the paired runtime hook owns the centered width correction and selected color. Apply one shared centered 1.05 horizontal-scale session to both Linked Mode choices while retaining the accepted title, base-row, and interval geometry.

font_layout_on_off_context.description: Route the Commands, Damage, and Guide Ninja Sound Practice Settings rows to the existing title-case Off/On selector table.

font_layout_command_relationships.description: Suppress only the second native Command Chart auxiliary-string draw after the runtime-injector adapter combines both optional relationship strings. Combine each Command Chart row's two optional relationship strings and render them once through one bounded two-line layout, then select the homologous icon-row offset according to whether the row has relationship text.

font_layout_core.description: Provide independent NUN5-compatible printable-ASCII measurement, shrink-only fitting, box positioning, explicit line measurement, and session-guarded renderer hooks for accepted caller-family adapters.

font_layout_global_selected_style.description: Apply one origin rule across every native NA2 gray-shadow selected renderer: keep the colored glyph at its ordinary origin and place its shadow one unit right and two units below.

font_layout_controls.description: Route the first eight Control Settings action labels through the v2 128-unit NUN5 box.

font_layout_titles.description: Route the two title-only BTL draw calls through one configurable v2 adapter with distinct 288-unit Command Chart and 352-unit Practice containers.

font_layout_pause_controls.description: Route both normal and selected Pause Controls rows through one shared 216-unit shrink-only box with the retained NUN5 four-unit Y correction.

font_layout_quit_confirmation.description: Route the shared quit-confirmation body and Yes/No list through draw-time wrapping and scoped NUN5 coordinate adapters, while exact Special Controls string-pointer guards reuse the same selected/unselected hooks.

font_layout_mode_select_confirmation.description: Route the dedicated Return to Title Screen body draw through NUN5 renderer state and retain the scoped Yes/No coordinate mapper for the top selector.

font_layout_character_select_modal.description: Route both selected and ordinary five-row entries through one bounded NUN5-metric session, render the return-confirmation body through NUN5's 368x24 secondary-font box, and scope only that confirmation's top Yes/No list through the shared NUN5 coordinate mapper.

font_layout_collection_confirmation.description: Route both Collection exit-confirmation body consumers and the bounded Yes/No list through NUN5-matched C geometry.

font_layout_collection_lists.description: Route the shared Collection row draw through family boxes and move the three character-header callers through two shared plaque-origin formulas without changing any displayed string.

font_layout_jutsu_selector.description: Route the exact Battle Settings Jutsu-row draw through a selective C entry that preserves native one-line rendering and uses the NUN5-homologous 186x32 two-line compositor only when wrapping is required.

font_layout_special_controls_body.description: Route only the exact Special Controls explanatory-body call through the shared draw-time word wrapper using the NUN5 400x60 two-line container.

font_layout_practice_explanations.description: Replace the per-token Practice explanation renderer with one NUN5-equivalent mixed text/icon buffer, unlimited word wrapping inside the 364x48 box, and call-local icon callbacks.

font_layout_settings_rows.description: Route the exact Battle Settings and Practice Settings loops through page-level label, heading, compact-token value, descriptive-phrase value, and digit-leading value templates.

font_layout_ninja_song_details.description: Replace the shared data-driven formula renderer used by all fifteen rows, retaining its three native formula variants while applying the NUN5 term boxes and positions; wrap every objective through one separate 288x32 prose template.

font_numeric_formatting.description: Static ASCII numeric-formatting data and call-site inputs. Resident ASCII numeric formatting for dynamic UI values.

font_numeric_save_load_separator.description: Replace the Save/Load-only fullwidth time colon with ASCII colon; the compiled-C runtime package owns all numeric formatting behavior.

font_numeric_ninja_song.description: Route all five dynamic Ninja Song decimal fields through one NUN5-compatible ASCII formatter while preserving each caller's width and padding mode.

font_numeric_save_load.description: Route the six accepted Save/Load numeric fields through typed C entries while retaining only register setup and symbolic hooks at the native call sites.

font_numeric_battle_settings.description: Route only ordinary Battle Settings Time through the shared ASCII C formatting layer while preserving the special 100/infinity path.

ui_layout.description: Localized graphical UI layout and geometry.

ui_layout_ultimate_jutsu_label.description: Make the OUGI label constructor instantiate one 128x64 regional label instead of two 64x64 Japanese halves.

ui_layout_stage_select.description: Use the official NUN5 stage-name UV table, horizontal fit, Random-prompt position, effective OK/Back anchors, and correct preview indexing while preserving NA2's 16-byte stage records.

ui_layout_character_name_rectangles.description: Replace the 96-entry Japanese character-name UV table with the complete official NUN5 English table used by CHARSEL1.CCS and the shared character-name atlases.

ui_layout_options_labels.description: Replace the five Japanese Options-menu and six difficulty-label UV rectangles with the complete official NUN5 English tables used by OPTION.CCS.

ui_layout_difficulty_sprite.description: Match NUN5's Options renderer by using the alternate sprite object for difficulty indices 0, 4, and 5 instead of only 0 and 5.

ui_layout_battle_hud_names.description: Cap the battle-HUD character-name display width at 160 pixels, matching NUN5 while preserving the full atlas source rectangle.

ui_layout_practice_settings_prompt.description: Use the official NUN5 English prompt rectangle and X anchor so the full label and Square icon fit the VS screen.

ui_layout_battle_hud_name_rectangles.description: Replace the separate 95-entry Japanese battle-HUD UV table with the official NUN5 English table used by CMN/GAUGE.CCS.

ui_layout_vs_confirmation.description: Use the official NUN5 Customize Jutsu, Battle Settings, arrows, input-glyph, Jutsu-label, OK, and Back records with NA2-specific anchor corrections where the two renderers differ.

ui_layout_round_label.description: Replace the two Japanese Round glyphs with the official one-part NUN5 English label and match its position and 1.2 scale.

ui_layout_jutsu_selector_arrows.description: Omit NA2's two closed-selector horizontal-arrow draws and render the official NUN5 arrow record vertically through a draw-scoped NA2 compatibility helper.

ui_layout_command_scroll_arrows.description: Copy the official NUN5 vertical-scroll triangle rectangle used by the shared Command Menu and Command Chart renderer.

ui_layout_item_status_paired.description: Import the official NUN5 paired item-status records and rank offsets, then port the anisotropic bubble and foreground layout contract without changing NA2's object ABI.

ui_layout_item_status_numeric.description: Import the official NUN5 Health, Chakra, and Recovery records and port the complete numeric top-label, lower-label, and one/two/three-digit layout through the shared NA2-compatible item helper.

ui_layout_item_status_single.description: Import the official NUN5 single-status records and port the shared origin, donor width scales, and record-specific quarter-turn without changing NA2's object ABI.

ui_layout_item_status_fixed.description: Reuse the donor-backed item records and shared width helper to center both fixed-class labels at NUN5's exact row positions without changing NA2's object ABI.

ui_layout_item_pickup_doll.description: Copy NUN5's exact substitution-doll item record over the homologous NA2 record selected by the live pickup updater.

ui_layout_mash_prompts.description: Copy the complete official NUN5 English seven-record main-prompt rectangle table used by the battle input overlay.

ui_layout_mode_select.description: Copy the official NUN5 English START-label rectangle, port its draw anchor, and reproduce NUN5's effective OK and Back anchors without changing NA2's renderer ABI.

ui_layout_controls_vibration.description: Copy the official NUN5 English Vibration-label rectangle used by the imported common UI atlas over NA2's narrow Japanese rectangle.

ui_layout_character_select_footer.description: Copy NUN5's exact Select Color and Random X-anchor instructions into the homologous NA2 Character Select footer renderer and reproduce NUN5's effective OK and Back anchors without changing NA2's renderer ABI.

ui_layout_common_prompts.description: Copy NUN5's exact Next, Triangle icon, Cancel label, empty-tail, and Stop records into NA2's shared compositor data, and reproduce NUN5's effective Options-root and Collection-footer anchors without changing NA2's renderer ABI.

ui_layout_options_footers.description: Copy NUN5's exact X-anchor instructions into the homologous Controls and Music Options Select calls, and reproduce NUN5's effective OK/Back anchors in both resident renderers.

ui_layout_collection_submenu.description: Copy NUN5's Characters, Movie, Music, Play, Previous Page, Next Page, and Collection viewer-control draw records into NA2's Collection tables.

ui_layout_victory_names.description: Derive every compatible NA2 prebuilt Victory name rectangle from the official NUN5 frame templates and English character-width table.

ui_layout_settings_footers.description: Import NUN5's exact Select anchors and reproduce its effective OK and Back anchors in NA2's homologous Battle and Practice Settings footer renderers.

ui_layout_battle_results.description: Copy the official NUN5 result-label, rank-atlas, title, moving-cloud, footer, and shared-prompt geometry into the homologous NA2 screens, and reproduce the NUN5 regional Ninja Song details-footer anchors while preserving NA2 renderer ABIs.
